title: Expedition 33 Trophy Guide - All Achievements
description: Complete trophy guide for Expedition 33 with roadmap, all 56 achievements, 5 missable trophies, step-by-step walkthrough, and tips for the hardest trophy.

sections.title: Trophy Roadmap (Difficulty 3/10, 50-70hrs)
sections.content:
Expedition 33 offers a manageable platinum/100% completion that mostly requires thorough exploration and completing endgame content. Here's the full roadmap overview:

CategoryDetails
Trophy Difficulty3/10
Estimated Time50-70 hours
Total Trophies56 (1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 5 Silver, 48 Bronze)
Online Trophies0 (fully offline)
Missable Trophies5
Minimum Playthroughs1
Difficulty Affects Trophies?No — play on any setting with accessibility options

Key Facts

  • All areas remain accessible after beating the final boss — load your save to continue exploring
  • No manual saves — the game rotates through 21 autosave slots
  • Force an autosave by choosing "Return to Title Screen" or changing an outfit item
  • New Game+ is NOT required for any trophy
  • The Auto QTE accessibility option works but deals less damage than manual inputs
  • Difficulty settings only affect enemy damage and dodge/parry window strictness — not enemy health

sections.title: Missable Trophies (5 Total)
sections.content:
These are the only permanently missable trophies in Expedition 33. Pay close attention to these during your playthrough:

TrophyWhenWhat to Do
Follow the TrailPrologueObtain the Old Key before leaving the second Prologue section
A Peculiar EncounterPrologueFight the optional Mime in the first Prologue area (no other Mime counts)
ConnoisseurAct 2Don't miss the optional Camp Interaction that gives a Record collectible
ProfessionalAny timeDefeat any boss without taking damage (return to Chromatic Lancelier overleveled)
MaelleAct 3Don't miss Maelle's relationship interaction during Act 3

Missable Details

Follow the Trail is the most critical — the Old Key is required to access all Journal entries throughout the game. Without it, the trophy is permanently locked regardless of everything else you collect.

A Peculiar Encounter specifically requires defeating the Prologue Mime. Despite encountering Mimes throughout the rest of the game (they typically reward cosmetics), only this first one counts.

Connoisseur may unlock early due to a possible glitch where two pickups exist for the same Record. However, don't rely on this — follow a collectible guide to be safe.

sections.title: Step 1: Prologue
sections.content:
The Prologue contains two critical missable items. Complete both before confirming the dialogue that progresses you out of each section.

First Prologue Section

  • Explore the entire area thoroughly before approaching the progression stairs
  • Find and defeat the Mime at the far end of the area to the right of the stairs — this is the only chance for the "A Peculiar Encounter" trophy
  • The Mime typically rewards an Outfit or Hairstyle item

Second Prologue Section

  • Before confirming any "continue" dialogue, search the area for the Old Key
  • This key is needed to unlock doors containing Journal entries throughout the rest of the game
  • Without it, the "Follow the Trail" (all Journals) trophy is permanently unobtainable

Progression Warning

Between each Prologue section there is a confirm dialogue you must agree to. The game autosaves after confirmation and you cannot return. Make absolutely sure you have both items before proceeding.

sections.title: Step 2: Act 1 & Act 2
sections.content:
Acts 1 and 2 cover the majority of the game's content. Focus on thorough exploration and be aware of one missable during Act 2.

Act 1 Goals

  • Complete all story dungeons: Spring Meadows, Flying Waters, Ancient Sanctuary, Gestral Village, Esquie's Nest, Stone Wave Cliffs
  • Defeat all optional bosses as you encounter them (or mark their locations for later)
  • Collect Journals, Records, Lost Gestrals, and Tints in every area
  • Consider skipping the Chromatic Lancelier fight and returning later for the "Professional" trophy — it's much easier when overleveled

Act 2 Goals

  • Progress through Forgotten Battlefield, Monoco's Station, Old Lumiere, Visages, Sirene, and The Monolith
  • Missable: Don't skip the optional Camp Interaction that rewards a Record — required for "Connoisseur" trophy
  • Continue collecting all available items and fighting optional bosses

Professional Trophy Strategy

For "Professional" (defeat a boss without taking damage), the easiest target is the Chromatic Lancelier in Spring Meadows. Return at Level 25+ and you can one-shot it before it attacks. Any Chromatic enemy counts, making this one of the simplest approaches.

sections.title: Step 3: Act 3 & Cleanup
sections.content:
Act 3 opens the full world map and is where you complete all remaining content. The Maelle missable occurs here.

Critical: Maelle's Interaction

During Act 3, actively seek out Maelle's relationship interaction at camp. This is the last missable event in the game. Missing it locks you out of the "Maelle" trophy. Check camp after each story progression point.

Post-Story Cleanup

After defeating the final boss, load your save to return to the last Expedition Flag. Everything remains accessible:

  • All remaining optional bosses (90+ encounters)
  • Endless Tower completion
  • Relationship level maximization for remaining characters
  • Collectible cleanup across all areas

Collectible Trophies Checklist

TrophyRequirementNotes
Follow the TrailAll JournalsRequires Old Key from Prologue
ConnoisseurAll RecordsIncludes missable Camp Record in Act 2
SaviorAll Lost Gestrals returnedFound across all areas, returned at Camp

sections.title: Hardest Trophy (Peace At Last / Simon)
sections.content:
The hardest trophy in Expedition 33 is "Peace At Last" — requiring you to defeat Simon, widely considered the game's most difficult boss.

About Simon

  • Location: Renoir's Drafts (accessible in Act 3/Postgame)
  • Recommended Level: 50+
  • Difficulty: Significantly harder than any story boss

Why Simon Is Hard

  • Multi-phase fight with increasing aggression
  • Very fast attack animations requiring precise parry timing
  • High damage output that can one-shot under-leveled characters
  • Mix of parryable and unparryable attacks in rapid succession
  • Long fight duration even with optimal damage output

Preparation Strategy

  • Level all party members to 50+ (55 is comfortable)
  • Fully upgrade your primary weapons to maximum
  • Equip Augmented Counter Pictos for parry damage
  • Bring Lune as dedicated healer with Revitalization and Tree of Life
  • Use Maelle in Virtuose Stance with Jarum or Lithum for sustained DPS
  • Stock maximum Elixirs and revival items

Fight Strategy

  • Phase 1: Learn all attack patterns — prioritize survival over damage
  • Phase 2: Simon becomes faster — switch to dodge for new attack patterns until you learn them
  • Phase 3: Full aggression once patterns are memorized. Use Break skills to interrupt his strongest attacks.
  • Parry his single strikes (big AP gain), dodge his sweeps and magic

sections.title: Collectible Trophies
sections.content:
Expedition 33 has four main collectible categories, each with an associated trophy. The game lacks a built-in region tracker, so following a guide is recommended.

Journals (Follow the Trail)

  • Found throughout all areas, often behind locked doors (Old Key required)
  • Some are in plain sight, others require environmental puzzle solving
  • Provide background lore about the world and previous expeditions
  • Total count: check every room, path, and hidden area in each dungeon

Music Records (Connoisseur)

  • Found in chests, from NPCs, and one missable Camp interaction in Act 2
  • Can be played at camp for ambient music changes
  • Note: This trophy may unlock early due to a known glitch with duplicate Record pickups

Lost Gestrals (Savior)

  • Small creatures hidden across all areas of The Continent
  • Return them to Camp for rewards (Pictos, materials, Chroma)
  • Some require Esquie mount or swimming ability to reach
  • Check behind waterfalls, inside caves, and on elevated platforms

Tints (Colorist)

  • Color customization options unlocked after Flying Waters
  • Found in chests and as rewards throughout the game
  • Less likely to miss than other collectibles since they're usually on main paths

General Tips

  • Revisit all areas after gaining swim and Esquie abilities — many collectibles are gated behind these
  • Paint Cages often contain collectibles — learn to spot and break them (shoot locks or destroy balloons)
  • Talk to every NPC at camp between story beats — some give Records or hint at collectible locations
